template.description: DB2 LUW 巡检模板（v11+/v12+，基于 JDBC 系统目录）

chapters.description: 版本 / 实例名 / 成员拓扑 / 库规模

queries.query_sql: SELECT (SELECT value FROM SYSIBMADM.DBMCFG WHERE name='instance_name') AS instance_name, CURRENT SERVER AS db_name FROM sysibm.sysdummy1
SELECT MEMBER_NUMBER AS member, PARTITION_NUMBER AS dbpartitionnum, HOST_NAME AS host, PORT_NUMBER AS port FROM TABLE(SYSPROC.DB_MEMBERS())

SELECT tbsp_name, tbsp_type, tbsp_state, TBSP_TOTAL_SIZE_KB AS tbsp_total_size, TBSP_USED_SIZE_KB AS tbsp_used_size, CASE WHEN TBSP_TOTAL_SIZE_KB>0 THEN TBSP_USED_SIZE_KB*100/TBSP_TOTAL_SIZE_KB ELSE 0 END AS used_pct FROM SYSIBMADM.TBSP_UTILIZATION

SELECT SNAPSHOT_TIMESTAMP, DB_NAME, AGENT_ID, APPL_NAME, AUTHID, TBSP_NAME, TABSCHEMA, TABNAME, TAB_FILE_ID, LOCK_OBJECT_TYPE, LOCK_NAME, LOCK_MODE, LOCK_STATUS, LOCK_ESCALATION, DBPARTITIONNUM, MEMBER FROM SYSIBMADM.LOCKS_HELD

SELECT STMT_TEXT, NUM_EXECUTIONS, STMT_EXEC_TIME AS TOTAL_EXEC_TIME, TOTAL_CPU_TIME, ROWS_READ, ROWS_RETURNED FROM TABLE(MON_GET_PKG_CACHE_STMT(NULL,'N',NULL,-2)) ORDER BY TOTAL_EXEC_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
queries.query_description_en: Top slow SQL by total exec time

queries.query_sql: SELECT indschema, indname, tabname, indextype, lastused, colnames FROM SYSCAT.INDEXES WHERE indschema NOT LIKE 'SYS%'
SELECT indname, tabname, stats_time, nleaf FROM SYSCAT.INDEXES

chapters.description: DB2 备份/恢复历史与最近结果（SYSIBMADM.DB_HISTORY）

queries.query_sql: SELECT START_TIME, END_TIME, OPERATION, OPERATIONTYPE, OBJECTTYPE, ENTRY_STATUS, SQLCODE, LOCATION, DEVICETYPE, NUM_TBSPS FROM SYSIBMADM.DB_HISTORY ORDER BY START_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY

chapters.description: 数据库级授权与审计策略状态（SYSCAT.DBAUTH / SYSCAT.AUDITPOLICIES）

queries.query_sql: SELECT GRANTEE, GRANTEETYPE, CONNECTAUTH, CREATETABAUTH, DBADMAUTH, SECURITYADMAUTH, DATAACCESSAUTH, ACCESSCTRLAUTH, EXPLAINAUTH FROM SYSCAT.DBAUTH ORDER BY GRANTEE

SELECT AUDITPOLICYNAME, AUDITSTATUS, CONTEXTSTATUS, VALIDATESTATUS, CHECKINGSTATUS, SYSADMINSTATUS, OBJMAINTSTATUS, SECMAINTSTATUS, EXECUTESTATUS, ERRORTYPE FROM SYSCAT.AUDITPOLICIES ORDER BY AUDITPOLICYNAME

chapters.description: HADR 运行状态与数据库配置（MON_GET_HADR / SYSIBMADM.DBCFG）

queries.query_sql: SELECT HADR_ROLE, HADR_STATE, HADR_SYNCMODE, HADR_CONNECT_STATUS, PRIMARY_MEMBER_HOST, STANDBY_MEMBER_HOST, LOG_HADR_WAIT_CUR, STANDBY_REPLAY_DELAY, READS_ON_STANDBY_ENABLED FROM TABLE(SYSPROC.MON_GET_HADR(NULL)) AS T
queries.query_description_zh: HADR 角色、状态与复制延迟
queries.query_description_en: HADR role, state and replay delay

queries.query_sql: SELECT NAME, VALUE FROM SYSIBMADM.DBCFG WHERE NAME LIKE 'hadr%' ORDER BY NAME
